#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

struct IntIntPair {
    int first;
    int second;

    IntIntPair(int f, int s) : first(f), second(s) {}

    bool operator==(const IntIntPair& other) const {
        return first == other.first && second == other.second;
    }
};

struct HashPair {
    size_t operator()(const IntIntPair& p) const {
        size_t h1 = hash<int>()(p.first);
        size_t h2 = hash<int>()(p.second);
        return h1 * 31 + h2;
    }
};

class TaskC {
public:
    const int BAD = 11111;
    int rows;
    int cols;
    vector<unordered_map<IntIntPair, int, HashPair>> mem;

    bool contains(int memVal, int index) {
        if (index < 0) return false;
        return ((memVal >> index) & 1) == 1;
    }

    int add(int memVal, int index) {
        if (!contains(memVal, index)) {
            memVal += (1 << index);
        }
        return memVal;
    }

    int size(int memVal) {
        int res = 0;
        while (memVal > 0) {
            if (memVal % 2 == 1) res++;
            memVal /= 2;
        }
        return res;
    }

    void test() {
        if (contains(5, 0) == false) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (contains(5, 1) == true) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (contains(5, -1) == true) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (contains(5, 2) == false) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (contains(5, 3) == true) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (add(0, 2) != 4) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (add(4, 0) != 5) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (add(5, 0) != 5) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
        if (size(5) != 2) throw runtime_error("Test failed");
    }

    int dp(int row, int remabove, int squareabove) {
        if (row == rows) {
            if (remabove == 0) return 0;
            return BAD;
        }
        IntIntPair key(remabove, squareabove);
        if (mem[row].find(key) != mem[row].end())
            return mem[row][key];

        int res = BAD;
        int possibilities = 1 << cols;
        for (int poss = 0; poss < possibilities; poss++) {
            int have = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                if (((poss >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    have = add(have, j);
                }
            }
            bool works = true;
            for (int above = 0; above < cols; above++) {
                if (contains(remabove, above)) {
                    if (!contains(have, above)) {
                        works = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (works) {
                int remhere = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    if (!contains(have, j - 1) && !contains(have, j) && !contains(have, j + 1) && !contains(squareabove, j)) {
                        remhere = add(remhere, j);
                    }
                }
                res = min(res, size(have) + dp(row + 1, remhere, have));
            }
        }
        mem[row][key] = res;
        return res;
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, int n, int m) {
        test();
        cols = min(n, m);
        rows = max(n, m);
        mem.resize(rows);
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            mem[i] = unordered_map<IntIntPair, int, HashPair>();
        }
        int res = dp(0, 0, 0);
        cout << cols * rows - res << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    istringstream iss(line);
    iss >> n >> m;
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve(1, n, m);
    return 0;
}
